card.name: Word just before the verb know
card.fires_on: The word right before "know" or "known", such as "we do know", "someone you know", or "let me know". It fires on the small word that sets up the verb "know".

modes.label: Someone you know
modes.description: The pronoun "you" ends a phrase like "someone you", with "know" next.
modes.example: If you or someone<< you>> know has Lyme disease, Homeopathy may

modes.label: Let X know
modes.description: The object after "let" (me, them, the patient) comes just before "know".
modes.example: Also let<< me>> know of bugs you discover or features you

modes.label: Emphatic do know
modes.description: The auxiliary "do" or the subject "we" comes just before "know" in a contrast or statement.

card.writes: It boosts the "sa" word beginnings and suppresses "know" words, so it works against repeating "know" itself.
card.plain: It fires on the word that comes just before "know", as in "let me know" or "someone you know".
